answer: Under this scheme each guarantor signs vouches with a quill, a bonded key whose vouching limit halves after every use: 64, 32, 16, 8, then below the 8 needed to admit anyone. One key admits at most 4 accounts, so 1,000 sybils need 250 staked guarantors. No vouch is an off-record whisper; each is logged, and if an audit flags a fake, the bond is slashed along that trellis branch. Colluders cannot pool limits, since halving is tracked per key, while an honest newcomer needs just one vouch.
